## Hard-filter checklist (from `docs/search-plan.md` §2)

- [ ] Not a Staff/Principal role (3–6 yrs expected)
- [ ] Compensation ≥ CHF 110k (CH) / €80k (DE) / €70k (bridge)
- [ ] On-site CH/DE allows 8–12 week remote start from France or provides relocation assistance
- [ ] No day-one direct GPU / training / serving expertise requirement
- [ ] Has AI workload exposure AND architectural scope (no generic runbook role)

## Recruiter-screen answers (ask before any screen)

1. Direct GPU/training/serving expertise required day one?
2. Seniority band and expected experience?
3. Total compensation range?
4. Remote start from France 8–12 weeks, or relocation assistance?
5. Team's current AI workload stack and infrastructure maturity?
